changes: Separate notification viewing from creation/retry permissions and keep independently verified history usable when channel configuration fails.
Save manual notification intent, actor audit and original recovery key atomically; queue failures preserve pending SQL records instead of inviting duplicate re-entry.
Recover due pending records while the API process is running, using deterministic job IDs and exclusive database delivery claims.
Retain uncertain provider results for review rather than automatically sending again; resolve late acknowledgements only for the original delivery claim.
Keep simulated, internal and real email modes separate, including legacy records that cannot be safely classified.
Mask unexpected provider/queue errors, bound provider and producer waits, and never expose configuration secrets in the workspace.
Show global counts, explicit applied filters, older history pages and Excel export scope instead of treating the last 100 records as all records.
Use responsive notification cards, compact aligned buttons, distinct status badges and readable multiline messages.

verification.unit_test_scope: Focused runs across service, provider, worker and queue suites. Latest worker/queue changes additionally checked in manager-notification-final-tests-20261122.log and manager-notification-queue-final-tests-20261122.log.
verification.database_scope: Actual migrations 013, 052 and 081 with synthetic isolated PostgreSQL data. Migration 081 was applied twice; 205 history records were traversed without duplicates.
verification.data_safety: No real Redis queue, email provider, customer message or live database was contacted. Provider requests in unit tests were mocked.

deployment_requirement: Apply migration 081 before starting the new API and publish the API and panel together. Old clients remain compatible; new clients require the mandatory-key creation route.
limitations: A provider acknowledgement means acceptance by the email provider, not delivery to the recipient inbox.
Uncertain external sends require provider-record review. This screen deliberately does not offer blind resend for them.
The pending-record recovery timer runs only while the API process is awake; no paid scheduler or always-on service was added.
Unverified legacy external pending records are marked for review rather than automatically converted to live sends.
Client request recovery lasts for the current screen session. After a full reload, inspect history before entering a replacement request.
manual_checks_pending: Browser layout and configured-provider delivery checks after deployment.
